study_design: Prospective nested case-control study using prediagnostic plasma and toenail specimens
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 117 of 145 men who developed prostate cancer and 233 matched control subjects had toenail and plasma samples available for assays of selenium, alpha-tocopherol, and gamma-tocopherol.
reason: The abstract explicitly examines subsequent incident prostate cancer in a nested case-control design, but it does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint. The analytic total is not stated directly and was not inferred by summing cases and controls.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The risk of prostate cancer declined, but not linearly, with increasing concentrations of alpha-tocopherol (odds ratio (highest versus lowest fifth) = 0.65; 95% confidence interval = 0.32--1.32; P(trend) =.28).
estimate_classifications.reason: The alpha-tocopherol estimate is for incident prostate cancer overall, not an aggressive subtype.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
